title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 092
review_goal: Differentiate thumb and toggle variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Thumb silhouette pointing downward with one squared wrist panel and one straighter finger block above it
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a more structured thumbs down hand with a clearer wrist and palm block.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rounder thumbs down when the hand should not collapse into one compact curved silhouette.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot separates the wrist and hand shape more clearly than the rounded thumbs down variant.

items.depicts_observation: Thumb silhouette pointing upward with one rounded back and one short cuff nub on the left
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the like cue to read as a compact rounded thumbs up shape.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the more structured thumbs up hand when the wrist and palm should look more segmented.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the rounder compact thumbs up instead of the more segmented hand silhouette.

items.depicts_observation: Thumb silhouette pointing upward with one squared wrist panel and one straighter finger block below it
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a more structured thumbs up hand with a clearer wrist block and palm edge.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rounded thumbs up when the hand should not collapse into a softer compact silhouette.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot separates the wrist and finger block more clearly than the rounded thumbs up variant.

items.depicts_observation: Toggle track with one large left circle fused into one short capsule on the right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the left toggle drawn as a fused shape with the knob swelling out from the track.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the capsule toggle when the switch should stay a full outline with the knob parked inside.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot merges the left knob into the track instead of placing it cleanly inside a full capsule outline.

items.depicts_observation: Long capsule outline with one inner circle knob parked on the left side
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the left toggle to keep the full capsule outline with the knob sitting inside it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the fused left toggle when the knob should not bulge out as part of the outer track shape.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps a full capsule around the switch and places the knob inside on the left.
